facts.value: Queries ftAnim_IsFramesRemaining(gobj); a false result forwards the same object to ftCo_80099010. That callee enters Furafura, restores shield_health from common x280, initializes grab_timer to max(common x2F8 - current damage percent, 0) + common x2FC, resets mash history through ftCommon_InitGrab, and calls ftCommon_8007EBAC(fp, 25, 0) and ft_800885A8(fp, 95, 127, 64). Only the damage-dependent term is clamped; the additive common value is not validated here.
